Verses.12: For the Word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it even penetrates as far as the division of soul and spirit, and joints and marrow. It judges the thoughts and attitudes of the heart.
Verses.13: No creature is hidden from His sight. Everything is open and laid bare to the eyes of Him to whom we must give account.
Verses.14: We have a great high priest who has ascended into heaven, Jesus, the Son of God. Therefore, let us hold firmly to the faith we profess.
Verses.15: For we do not have a high priest who cannot sympathize with our weakness. Instead, we have one who has been tempted in every way we could be, yet is without sin.
Verses.16: Therefore, let us approach the throne of grace with confidence. Then we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.

Changes: 2025-02-02 - Paul Prins: First translation of verses 12-16 based on Greek.
